<function name="InternalKeyTyped" parent="gui" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Simulates an ASCII symbol writing.
Use to write text in the chat or in VGUI.
Doesn't work while the main menu is open!
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="code" type="number">ASCII code of symbol, see [this chart](https://files.facepunch.com/wiki/files/ab571/8dc389806d65b98.gif).</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Writes "Hello" every think.</description>
	<code>
hook.Add("Think","Example",function()
	gui.InternalKeyTyped(72)
	gui.InternalKeyTyped(101)
	gui.InternalKeyTyped(108)
	gui.InternalKeyTyped(108)
	gui.InternalKeyTyped(111)
end)
	</code>

</example>
